stops.note: to call to one's aid, from ad- (to) and vocare (to call)
first recorded in 1340 in the 'Ayenbite of Inwyt', a Kentish monk's translation of the French moral treatise 'Somme le Roi'
stops.meaning: a person who publicly supports a cause, or to support it

current_meaning: a person who publicly supports a cause, or to publicly recommend something
